# Aprende español

> Free Russian-language app for learning Spanish by reading public-domain
> Spanish literature with an integrated word glossary, plus themed vocabulary
> lists with translations and examples. No registration, no payment.

- [Home](https://niceio.com/): choose a book or a word category
- [About](https://niceio.com/about/): what the app is for
- [Privacy](https://niceio.com/privacy/): cookies and Google Analytics
